solarbeam.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.
solarbeam.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
spikes.shortDesc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.

spite.name: Spite
spite.desc: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.
spite.shortDesc: Lowers the PP of the target's last move by 4.

spitup.name: Spit Up
spitup.desc: Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Whether or not this move is successful, the user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
spitup.shortDesc: More power with more uses of Stockpile.

spore.name: Spore
spore.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
spore.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

steelwing.name: Steel Wing
steelwing.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
steelwing.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.
stockpile.shortDesc: Raises user's Defense, Sp. Def by 1. Max 3 uses.

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
stomp.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

stringshot.name: String Shot
stringshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

struggle.name: Struggle
struggle.desc: Deals typeless damage to a random opposing Pokemon. If this move was successful, the user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and the Rock Head Ability does not prevent this. This move is automatically used if none of the user's known moves can be selected.
struggle.shortDesc: User loses 1/4 of its max HP.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.desc: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, if the user switches out or faints, or if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.
substitute.shortDesc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.

sunnyday.name: Sunny Day
sunnyday.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sunny Day. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sunny Day.
sunnyday.shortDesc: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.

superfang.name: Super Fang
superfang.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
superfang.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.desc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
superpower.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

supersonic.name: Supersonic
supersonic.desc: Causes the target to become confused.
supersonic.shortDesc: Causes the target to become confused.

surf.name: Surf
surf.desc: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.
surf.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dive.

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.
swagger.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 and confuses it.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.desc: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
swallow.shortDesc: Heals the user based on uses of Stockpile.

sweetkiss.name: Sweet Kiss
sweetkiss.desc: Causes the target to become confused.
sweetkiss.shortDesc: Causes the target to become confused.

sweetscent.name: Sweet Scent
sweetscent.desc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.

swift.name: Swift
swift.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
swift.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.

swordsdance.name: Swords Dance
swordsdance.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
synthesis.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

tailglow.name: Tail Glow
tailglow.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack by 3 stages.
tailglow.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 3.

tailwhip.name: Tail Whip
tailwhip.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

takedown.name: Take Down
takedown.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
taunt.shortDesc: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.

teeterdance.name: Teeter Dance
teeterdance.desc: Causes the target to become confused.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

thief.name: Thief
thief.desc: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mail or Z-Crystal, or if the target is a Kyogre holding a Blue Orb, a Groudon holding a Red Orb, a Giratina holding a Griseous Orb, an Arceus holding a Plate, a Genesect holding a Drive, a Silvally holding a Memory, or a Pokemon that can Mega Evolve holding the Mega Stone for its species. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
thief.shortDesc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
thrash.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
thunder.shortDesc: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thunderpunch.name: Thunder Punch
thunderpunch.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thundershock.name: Thunder Shock
thundershock.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thunderwave.name: Thunder Wave
thunderwave.desc: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
tickle.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1.

torment.name: Torment
torment.desc: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
torment.shortDesc: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
toxic.shortDesc: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.

transform.name: Transform
transform.desc: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.
transform.shortDesc: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.

triattack.name: Tri Attack
triattack.desc: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
triattack.shortDesc: 20% chance to paralyze or burn or freeze target.

trick.name: Trick
trick.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if neither is holding an item, if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, a Red Orb, a Griseous Orb, a Plate, a Drive, or a Memory to or from a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, or a Silvally, respectively. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
trick.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.

triplekick.name: Triple Kick
triplekick.desc: Hits three times. Power increases to 20 for the second hit and 30 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
triplekick.shortDesc: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.

twister.name: Twister
twister.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.
twister.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.desc: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
uproar.shortDesc: Lasts 3 turns. Active Pokemon cannot fall asleep.

volttackle.name: Volt Tackle
volttackle.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
volttackle.shortDesc: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
waterpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

waterspout.name: Water Spout
waterspout.desc: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
waterspout.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

weatherball.name: Weather Ball
weatherball.desc: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Delta Stream is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Desolate Land or Sunny Day. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Desolate Land, or Sunny Day, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.
weatherball.shortDesc: Power doubles and type varies in each weather.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
whirlpool.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
whirlwind.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
wish.shortDesc: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
wrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.
yawn.shortDesc: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.

zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapcannon.desc: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

airlock.name: Air Lock
airlock.desc: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.
airlock.shortDesc: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

arenatrap.name: Arena Trap
arenatrap.desc: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne, are holding a Shed Shell, or are a Ghost type.
arenatrap.shortDesc: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne.

battlearmor.name: Battle Armor
battlearmor.desc: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
battlearmor.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.
blaze.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Fire attacks.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.desc: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
chlorophyll.shortDesc: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

clearbody.name: Clear Body
clearbody.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
clearbody.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

cloudnine.name: Cloud Nine
cloudnine.desc: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.
cloudnine.shortDesc: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

colorchange.name: Color Change
colorchange.desc: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the last move that hit it, unless that type is already one of its types. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
colorchange.shortDesc: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of a move it's hit by, unless it has the type.

compoundeyes.name: Compound Eyes
compoundeyes.desc: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.
compoundeyes.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.

cutecharm.name: Cute Charm
cutecharm.desc: There is a 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will become infatuated if it is of the opposite gender.
cutecharm.shortDesc: 30% chance of infatuating Pokemon of the opposite gender if they make contact.

damp.name: Damp
damp.desc: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.
damp.shortDesc: Prevents Explosion/Mind Blown/Misty Explosion/Self-Destruct/Aftermath while active.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain Dance.
drizzle.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain Dance.

drought.name: Drought
drought.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sunny Day.
drought.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sunny Day.

earlybird.name: Early Bird
earlybird.desc: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.
earlybird.shortDesc: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.

effectspore.name: Effect Spore
effectspore.desc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned, paralyzed, or fall asleep.
effectspore.shortDesc: 30% chance of poison/paralysis/sleep on others making contact with this Pokemon.

flamebody.name: Flame Body
flamebody.desc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.
flamebody.shortDesc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.

flashfire.name: Flash Fire
flashfire.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.
flashfire.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Fire attacks do 1.5x damage if hit by one Fire move; Fire immunity.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.desc: If this Pokemon is a Castform, its type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella and the weather is Rain Dance or Sunny Day.
forecast.shortDesc: Castform's type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm.

guts.name: Guts
guts.desc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Attack is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon's physical attacks ignore the burn effect of halving damage.
guts.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is statused, its Attack is 1.5x; ignores burn halving physical damage.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the accuracy of its physical attacks is multiplied by 0.8.
hustle.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5x and accuracy of its physical attacks is 0.8x.

hypercutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hypercutter.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.
hypercutter.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
illuminate.shortDesc: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.desc: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.
immunity.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

innerfocus.name: Inner Focus
innerfocus.desc: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
innerfocus.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.desc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
insomnia.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.
intimidate.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.

keeneye.name: Keen Eye
keeneye.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
keeneye.shortDesc: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.
levitate.shortDesc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.

lightningrod.name: Lightning Rod
lightningrod.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.
lightningrod.shortDesc: This Pokemon draws Electric moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Electric immunity.

limber.name: Limber
limber.desc: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.
limber.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

liquidooze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquidooze.desc: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.
liquidooze.shortDesc: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.

magmaarmor.name: Magma Armor
magmaarmor.desc: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.
magmaarmor.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

magnetpull.name: Magnet Pull
magnetpull.desc: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell or are a Ghost type.
magnetpull.shortDesc: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out.

marvelscale.name: Marvel Scale
marvelscale.desc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
marvelscale.shortDesc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

minus.name: Minus
minus.desc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.
minus.shortDesc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5x.

naturalcure.name: Natural Cure
naturalcure.desc: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.
naturalcure.shortDesc: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.desc: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
oblivious.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Immune to Intimidate.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
overgrow.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Grass attacks.

owntempo.name: Own Tempo
owntempo.desc: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
owntempo.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Immune to Intimidate.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.desc: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.
pickup.shortDesc: If this Pokemon has no item, it finds one used by an adjacent Pokemon this turn.

plus.name: Plus
plus.desc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.
plus.shortDesc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5x.

poisonpoint.name: Poison Point
poisonpoint.desc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.
poisonpoint.shortDesc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.desc: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.
pressure.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is the target of a foe's move, that move loses one additional PP.

raindish.name: Rain Dish
raindish.desc: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
raindish.shortDesc: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.

rockhead.name: Rock Head
rockhead.desc: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.
rockhead.shortDesc: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage besides Struggle/Life Orb/crash damage.

roughskin.name: Rough Skin
roughskin.desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.
roughskin.shortDesc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.

sandstream.name: Sand Stream
sandstream.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.
sandstream.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

sandveil.name: Sand Veil
sandveil.desc: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
sandveil.shortDesc: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25x; immunity to Sandstorm.

serenegrace.name: Serene Grace
serenegrace.desc: This Pokemon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled. This effect stacks with the Rainbow effect, except for secondary effects that cause the target to flinch.
serenegrace.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled.

shadowtag.name: Shadow Tag
shadowtag.desc: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell, are a Ghost type, or also have this Ability.
shadowtag.shortDesc: Prevents foes from choosing to switch unless they also have this Ability.

shedskin.name: Shed Skin
shedskin.desc: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.
shedskin.shortDesc: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its status cured at the end of each turn.

shellarmor.name: Shell Armor
shellarmor.desc: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
shellarmor.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

shielddust.name: Shield Dust
shielddust.desc: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack. Attacks with secondary effects that are prevented include those with a chance (even 100%) to paralyze, sleep, freeze, burn, poison, confuse, cause this Pokemon to flinch, cause this Pokemon's stat stages to be lowered, as well as Anchor Shot, Eerie Spell, Fling, Psychic Noise, Salt Cure, Spirit Shackle, Syrup Bomb, and Throat Chop. The effect of Sparkling Aria is prevented if this Pokemon is the only target. Secondary effects added by King's Rock, Razor Fang, and the Poison Touch, Stench, and Toxic Chain Abilities are also prevented against this Pokemon.
shielddust.shortDesc: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.desc: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.
soundproof.shortDesc: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.

speedboost.name: Speed Boost
speedboost.desc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage at the end of each full turn it has been on the field.
speedboost.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage at the end of each full turn on the field.

static.name: Static
static.desc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.
static.shortDesc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

stench.name: Stench
stench.desc: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
stench.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to flinch gain a 10% chance to flinch.

stickyhold.name: Sticky Hold
stickyhold.desc: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack, unless the attack knocks out this Pokemon. A Sticky Barb will be transferred to other Pokemon regardless of this Ability.
stickyhold.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.desc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokemon.
sturdy.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO.

suctioncups.name: Suction Cups
suctioncups.desc: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.
suctioncups.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack.
swarm.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Bug attacks.

swiftswim.name: Swift Swim
swiftswim.desc: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
swiftswim.shortDesc: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.desc: If another Pokemon burns, paralyzes, poisons, or badly poisons this Pokemon, that Pokemon receives the same non-volatile status condition.
synchronize.shortDesc: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes this Pokemon, it also gets that status.

thickfat.name: Thick Fat
thickfat.desc: If a Pokemon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.
thickfat.shortDesc: Fire-/Ice-type moves against this Pokemon deal damage with a halved offensive stat.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
torrent.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.

trace.name: Trace
trace.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies a random opposing Pokemon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.
trace.shortDesc: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.

truant.name: Truant
truant.desc: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.
truant.shortDesc: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.

vitalspirit.name: Vital Spirit
vitalspirit.desc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
vitalspirit.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

voltabsorb.name: Volt Absorb
voltabsorb.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.
voltabsorb.shortDesc: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.

waterabsorb.name: Water Absorb
waterabsorb.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.
waterabsorb.shortDesc: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.

waterveil.name: Water Veil
waterveil.desc: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
waterveil.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

whitesmoke.name: White Smoke
whitesmoke.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
whitesmoke.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

wonderguard.name: Wonder Guard
wonderguard.desc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
wonderguard.shortDesc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
